C0973.title: Officials Step In Over Suspected Actor Behavior, Beimu Fires Back with Four Videos
C0973.summary: In a Honor of Kings peak match, a player using Hou Yi locked in the hero at the last second, disconnected mid-game, and contributed almost nothing, drawing suspicion of actor behavior. Streamer Beimu submitted the match record via the streamer channel to official review, and the player was banned for three months for intentionally manipulating the match. Dissatisfied, the Hou Yi player posted four videos to proclaim innocence and request unbanning, sparking debate over passive gameplay and punishment severity in high-rank matches.
